output.reason: The linked PR [ev-a9cb29a92bf0] names the subject: the type the composite reconciler uses to watch composed resources in real time compositions. It also states the change: from composed.Unstructured to the Kubernetes unstructured.Unstructured type that is already used for XR watches. Applicability is stated directly: it matters when real time compositions are in use and an XR is itself a composed resource (nested XRs) [ev-a9cb29a92bf0]. For the consequence, [ev-cffb68f85665] says that when the two types differ, the underlying watch hits an unhandled unexpected-type error (fixes #5957 and #6455), and the change is confined to the composite reconciler [ev-5ddf0dbaee45]; the user-visible effect of that watch failure is only described in the linked issue comment, which is not shown, so confidence is low.
